meta.annual_data_note: World Bank publishes ANNUAL data only — no quarterly breakdown available. Data typically has a 1–2 year publication lag (in 2026, confirmed data for most countries runs to 2023 or 2024). 2025 and 2026 rows are included but will be marked 'missing_official' until WB publishes them. For quarterly GDP / CPI, use national statistics offices: Thailand → NESDC, Vietnam → GSO, Singapore → SingStat, Indonesia → BPS, Malaysia → DOSM. Forecasts for 2025/2026 are stored separately in latest_estimates.json and labeled 'forecast_estimate'.

gdpGrowth.label: GDP Growth Rate
gdpGrowth.note: Annual GDP growth at constant prices. World Bank does NOT publish quarterly GDP. For quarterly data use national statistics offices.

gdpNominal.label: GDP (Current USD)
gdpNominal.note: GDP in current US dollars, divided by 1 billion. Not inflation-adjusted.

inflation.label: Inflation (CPI)
inflation.note: Annual average Consumer Price Index change. Myanmar post-2022 figures are IMF estimates. Monthly CPI available from IMF IFS database.

unemployment.label: Unemployment Rate
unemployment.note: ILO modelled estimates — may differ from nationally reported figures. Brunei has partial coverage.

fdiPctGdp.label: FDI Net Inflows
fdiPctGdp.note: Balance-of-payments FDI net inflows as % of GDP. Negative values mean net outflow. Singapore may show large swings due to round-tripping through holding companies.

exports.label: Exports of Goods & Services
exports.note: Exports of goods AND services in current USD, scaled to billions. Singapore's figure includes massive re-export component — legitimately exceeds $900B in recent years.

imports.label: Imports of Goods & Services
imports.note: Imports of goods AND services in current USD, scaled to billions.

population.label: Total Population
population.note: Mid-year total population estimate, scaled to millions.
